theorem norm_embedding_le_mulHeight₁ {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K] (x : K)
    (φ : K →+* ℂ) : ‖φ x‖ ≤ Height.mulHeight₁ x := by
  have h1 : Real.posLog (InfinitePlace.mk φ x) ≤ Height.logHeight₁ x := by
    rw [logHeight₁_eq]
    have hfin : 0 ≤ ∑ᶠ v : FinitePlace K, Real.posLog (v x) :=
      finsum_nonneg fun _ ↦ Real.posLog_nonneg
    have hinf : Real.posLog (InfinitePlace.mk φ x) ≤
        ∑ v : InfinitePlace K, (v.mult : ℝ) * Real.posLog (v x) :=
      calc Real.posLog (InfinitePlace.mk φ x)
          ≤ ((InfinitePlace.mk φ).mult : ℝ) * Real.posLog (InfinitePlace.mk φ x) :=
            le_mul_of_one_le_left Real.posLog_nonneg InfinitePlace.one_le_mult
        _ ≤ _ := Finset.single_le_sum
            (f := fun v : InfinitePlace K ↦ (v.mult : ℝ) * Real.posLog (v x))
            (fun v _ ↦ mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) Real.posLog_nonneg) (Finset.mem_univ _)
    exact hinf.trans (le_add_of_nonneg_right hfin)
  rw [InfinitePlace.apply, Height.logHeight₁_eq_log_mulHeight₁] at h1
  have h2 : ‖φ x‖ ≤ Real.exp (Real.posLog ‖φ x‖) := by
    rcases eq_or_ne (φ x) 0 with h | h
    · rw [h, norm_zero]
      exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
    · calc ‖φ x‖ = Real.exp (Real.log ‖φ x‖) := (Real.exp_log (norm_pos_iff.mpr h)).symm
        _ ≤ Real.exp (Real.posLog ‖φ x‖) :=
            Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by rw [Real.posLog_apply]; exact le_max_right _ _)
  calc ‖φ x‖ ≤ Real.exp (Real.posLog ‖φ x‖) := h2
    _ ≤ Real.exp (Real.log (Height.mulHeight₁ x)) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h1
    _ = Height.mulHeight₁ x := Real.exp_log (Height.mulHeight₁_pos x)

theorem natDegree_minpoly_int_le {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K] {y : K}
    (hy : IsIntegral ℤ y) : (minpoly ℤ y).natDegree ≤ Module.finrank ℚ K := by

  exact minpoly.natDegree_le _

theorem coeff_minpoly_int_mem_Icc {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K] {y : K}
    (hy : IsIntegral ℤ y) {d : ℕ} (hd : Module.finrank ℚ K ≤ d) {B : ℝ}
    (hB : ∀ φ : K →+* ℂ, ‖φ y‖ ≤ B) (i : ℕ) :
    (minpoly ℤ y).coeff i ∈ Set.Icc (-(coeffBoundOf d B : ℤ)) (coeffBoundOf d B) := by
  have hpQ : minpoly ℚ y = (minpoly ℤ y).map (algebraMap ℤ ℚ) :=
    minpoly.isIntegrallyClosed_eq_field_fractions' ℚ hy
  have hpdeg : (minpoly ℚ y).natDegree ≤ d := (minpoly.natDegree_le _).trans hd
  have h := coeff_bdd_of_roots_le (B := B) (algebraMap ℚ ℂ)
    (minpoly.monic (Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral y))
    (IsAlgClosed.splits _) hpdeg (fun z hz ↦ ?_) i
  · rw [hpQ, Polynomial.map_map, coeff_map] at h
    have hcast : ((algebraMap ℚ ℂ).comp (algebraMap ℤ ℚ)) ((minpoly ℤ y).coeff i) =
        (((minpoly ℤ y).coeff i : ℤ) : ℂ) := by
      simp
    rw [hcast, Complex.norm_intCast] at h
    rw [Set.mem_Icc, ← abs_le, coeffBoundOf]
    exact_mod_cast h.trans (Nat.le_ceil _)
  · classical
    rw [← Multiset.mem_toFinset] at hz
    obtain ⟨φ, rfl⟩ := (Embeddings.range_eval_eq_rootSet_minpoly K ℂ y).symm.subset hz
    exact hB φ

Here n_v is 1 for a real place and 2 for a complex place. Finite-place absolute values use the norm normalization |a|_v = N(v)^{−ord_v(a)} for a ≠ 0. All absolute values take 0 to 0. The infinite product notation at finite places has only finitely many factors different from 1. The infinite places with these multiplicities account for all complex embeddings. Write ℓ_K(a) = log M_K(a). These field-relative heights do not divide by [K:ℚ].

Fix an algebraic closure ℚ̄ of ℚ. The points are the algebraic numbers λ ∈ ℚ̄ with λ ≠ 0 and λ ≠ 1. For each point separately, let F_λ = ℚ(λ) ⊆ ℚ̄ be its minimal point field. theorem boundedDegreeFiniteness_of_northcott_children
    (hRoots : Northcott.FiniteRoots)
    (hWitness : Northcott.PolynomialWitness) : BoundedDegreeFiniteness := by
  classical
  intro d H
  -- the finite set `T` of the quotients `y / n` of the roots `y` of the polynomials of
  -- `polySet d H` by the integers `1 ≤ n ≤ heightBound d H`
  have hTfin : (⋃ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊heightBound d H⌋₊, (fun y : Qbar ↦ (n : Qbar)⁻¹ * y) ''
      (⋃ f ∈ polySet d H, ((f.map (Int.castRingHom Qbar)).roots.toFinset : Set Qbar))).Finite :=
    (Finset.finite_toSet _).biUnion fun n _ ↦ (hRoots d H).image _
  refine (hTfin.preimage Subtype.val_injective.injOn).subset fun x ⟨hd, hH⟩ ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨n, hn0, hnB, p, hp, hpm, hroot⟩ := hWitness hd hH
  have hn' : (n : Qbar) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hn0
  simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_image, Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_Icc,
    Multiset.mem_toFinset, exists_prop]
  refine ⟨n, ⟨Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hn0, Nat.le_floor hnB⟩, (n : Qbar) * x.1,
    ⟨p, hp, ?_⟩, inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hn' _⟩
  rw [mem_roots (hpm.map (Int.castRingHom Qbar)).ne_zero, IsRoot.def, eval_map]
  exact hroot

For a number field K and a ∈ K, let M_K(a) be the unnormalized multiplicative height. Explicitly, M_K(a) = ∏_{v infinite} max(1,|a|_v)^{n_v} · ∏_{v finite} max(1,|a|_v). Write ℓ_K(a) = log M_K(a). These field-relative heights do not divide by [K:ℚ].

Fix an algebraic closure ℚ̄ of ℚ. The points are the algebraic numbers λ ∈ ℚ̄ with λ ≠ 0 and λ ≠ 1. For each point separately, let F_λ = ℚ(λ) ⊆ ℚ̄ be its minimal point field. theorem northcottPolynomialWitness : Northcott.PolynomialWitness := by
  intro d H x hd hH
  have hmul := mulHeight₁_gen_le hd hH
  have hB₀_pos := heightBound_pos d H
  obtain ⟨n, hn0, hnle, hint⟩ := exists_nat_le_mulHeight₁ (gen x.1)
  have hnB : (n : ℝ) ≤ heightBound d H := hnle.trans hmul
  have hd' : Module.finrank ℚ (fieldOf x.1) ≤ d := by
    rw [← deg_eq_finrank]
    exact hd
  have hconj : ∀ φ : fieldOf x.1 →+* ℂ,
      ‖φ ((n : fieldOf x.1) * gen x.1)‖ ≤ heightBound d H * heightBound d H := by
    intro φ
    rw [map_mul, norm_mul, map_natCast, Complex.norm_natCast]
    exact mul_le_mul hnB ((norm_embedding_le_mulHeight₁ _ φ).trans hmul) (norm_nonneg _)
      hB₀_pos.le
  refine ⟨n, hn0, hnB, _, ⟨(natDegree_minpoly_int_le hint).trans hd',
    coeff_minpoly_int_mem_Icc hint hd' hconj⟩, minpoly.monic hint, ?_⟩
  -- `nλ` is a root of its minimal polynomial
  have hy : (n : Qbar) * x.1 = algebraMap (fieldOf x.1) Qbar ((n : fieldOf x.1) * gen x.1) := by
    simp
  rw [hy]
  exact eval₂_minpoly_int_algebraMap _ Qbar

proof_notes.en: The proof works in the actual minimal point field F_λ = ℚ(λ). It chooses a nonzero natural denominator n ≤ M_{F_λ}(λ) such that nλ is an algebraic integer there. It bounds |φ(nλ)| by B(d,H)^2 for every embedding φ: F_λ → ℂ. It then chooses the monic integer minimal polynomial of nλ, bounds its degree and coefficients, and maps its evaluation back to ℚ̄. The chosen polynomial is this minimal polynomial, although the statement requires only a monic polynomial with the stated bounds.

declarations.en:
For a number field K and a ∈ K, let M_K(a) be the unnormalized multiplicative height. Explicitly, M_K(a) = ∏_{v infinite} max(1,|a|_v)^{n_v} · ∏_{v finite} max(1,|a|_v). Here n_v is 1 for a real place and 2 for a complex place. Finite-place absolute values use the norm normalization |a|_v = N(v)^{−ord_v(a)} for a ≠ 0. All absolute values take 0 to 0. The infinite product notation at finite places has only finitely many factors different from 1. The infinite places with these multiplicities account for all complex embeddings. Write ℓ_K(a) = log M_K(a). These field-relative heights do not divide by [K:ℚ].

Fix an algebraic closure ℚ̄ of ℚ. The points are the algebraic numbers λ ∈ ℚ̄ with λ ≠ 0 and λ ≠ 1. For each point separately, let F_λ = ℚ(λ) ⊆ ℚ̄ be its minimal point field. Put δ(λ) = [F_λ:ℚ], equivalently the degree of the minimal polynomial of λ over ℚ. The canonical generator of F_λ maps to this same λ in ℚ̄. Define its normalized absolute logarithmic height by h(λ) = ℓ_{F_λ}(λ)/δ(λ). The fields F_λ vary with λ; no single containing number field is fixed. The height h is the degree-normalized absolute height, while ℓ_{F_λ} is unnormalized.

For d ∈ ℕ and H ∈ ℝ, define B(d,H) = exp(d · max(H,0)). Natural numbers include zero, and H need not be nonnegative.

For d ∈ ℕ and b ∈ ℝ, define C(d,b) = ⌈max(b,1)^d · binom(d,⌊d/2⌋)⌉_ℕ. Here ⌈r⌉_ℕ is the natural-number ceiling, equal to max(0,⌈r⌉). The quotient d/2 in the binomial index is integer division. No sign condition on b is imposed.

Define A(d,H) = C(d,B(d,H)^2).

Let 𝒫(d,H) be the set of all integer polynomials f with natural-number degree at most d and −A(d,H) ≤ a_i ≤ A(d,H) for every coefficient a_i. The natural-number degree of the zero polynomial is defined as zero, so 𝒫(d,H) includes the zero polynomial. No monicity condition is part of this set.

For every d ∈ ℕ, H ∈ ℝ, and point λ ∈ ℚ̄\{0,1} with δ(λ) ≤ d and h(λ) ≤ H, there exist n ∈ ℕ and p ∈ 𝒫(d,H) such that n ≠ 0, n ≤ B(d,H), p is monic, and p(nλ) = 0 in ℚ̄. The point nλ in the conclusion is the integer multiple of the same original λ. No choice of one fixed number field for all λ is a premise.

固定 ℚ 的代数闭包 ℚ̄。点是满足 λ ≠ 0 且 λ ≠ 1 的代数数 λ ∈ ℚ̄。对每个点分别取其最小点域 F_λ = ℚ(λ) ⊆ ℚ̄，并记 δ(λ) = [F_λ:ℚ]，它也等于 λ 在 ℚ 上的最小多项式次数。最小点域中的典范生成元在 ℚ̄ 中的像就是同一个 λ。定义归一化绝对对数高度 h(λ) = ℓ_{F_λ}(λ)/δ(λ)。点域 F_λ 随 λ 变化，不固定一个包含所有点的数域。h 是按次数归一化的绝对高度，而 ℓ_{F_λ} 未归一化。

对自然数 d 和实数 H，定义 B(d,H) = exp(d · max(H,0))。自然数包括零，不要求 H 非负。

对自然数 d 和实数 b，定义 C(d,b) = ⌈max(b,1)^d · 二项式系数(d,⌊d/2⌋)⌉_ℕ。其中 ⌈r⌉_ℕ 是自然数上取整，等于 max(0,⌈r⌉)；二项式系数下标中的 d/2 采用整数除法。不对 b 加符号条件。

定义 A(d,H) = C(d,B(d,H)^2)。

记 𝒫(d,H) 为所有满足下述条件的整数系数多项式 f 的集合：自然数次数不超过 d，且每个系数 a_i 都满足 −A(d,H) ≤ a_i ≤ A(d,H)。零多项式的自然数次数约定为零，因此零多项式属于 𝒫(d,H)。该集合的定义不要求多项式首一。

对每个自然数 d、实数 H 及满足 δ(λ) ≤ d 和 h(λ) ≤ H 的点 λ ∈ ℚ̄\{0,1}，存在自然数 n 和多项式 p ∈ 𝒫(d,H)，使 n ≠ 0、n ≤ B(d,H)、p 首一，且在 ℚ̄ 中有 p(nλ) = 0。结论中的 nλ 是原来同一个点 λ 的整数倍。不要求所有 λ 都属于某一个固定数域。
declarations.ja:
数体 K と a ∈ K に対し、M_K(a) を正規化前の乗法的高さとする。具体的には M_K(a) = ∏_{v は無限素点} max(1,|a|_v)^{n_v} · ∏_{v は有限素点} max(1,|a|_v) である。実素点では n_v = 1、複素素点では n_v = 2 とする。有限素点の絶対値は a ≠ 0 に対して |a|_v = N(v)^{−ord_v(a)} と正規化する。すべての絶対値は零を零に写す。有限素点の積で 1 と異なる因子は有限個である。この重複度を持つ無限素点は、すべての複素埋め込みを数える。ℓ_K(a) = log M_K(a) とおく。これらの数体に相対的な高さは [K:ℚ] では割らない。

ℚ の代数閉包 ℚ̄ を固定する。点は λ ≠ 0 かつ λ ≠ 1 を満たす代数数 λ ∈ ℚ̄ である。各点について最小の点の定義体 F_λ = ℚ(λ) ⊆ ℚ̄ を取り、δ(λ) = [F_λ:ℚ] とおく。これは λ の ℚ 上の最小多項式の次数でもある。F_λ の標準的な生成元の ℚ̄ における像は、同じ λ である。正規化された絶対対数的高さを h(λ) = ℓ_{F_λ}(λ)/δ(λ) と定める。F_λ は λ に応じて変わり、すべての点を含む一つの数体を固定しない。h は次数で正規化した絶対的高さであり、ℓ_{F_λ} は正規化前の高さである。

自然数 d と実数 H に対し B(d,H) = exp(d · max(H,0)) と定める。自然数には零を含み、H が非負であるとは仮定しない。

自然数 d と実数 b に対し C(d,b) = ⌈max(b,1)^d · 二項係数(d,⌊d/2⌋)⌉_ℕ と定める。⌈r⌉_ℕ は自然数への切り上げであり、max(0,⌈r⌉) に等しい。二項係数の添字の d/2 は整数除算である。b の符号に仮定はない。

A(d,H) = C(d,B(d,H)^2) と定める。

𝒫(d,H) を、自然数値の次数が d 以下で、すべての係数 a_i が −A(d,H) ≤ a_i ≤ A(d,H) を満たす整数係数多項式 f の集合とする。零多項式の自然数値の次数は零と定めるので、零多項式も 𝒫(d,H) に含まれる。この集合ではモニックであることを要求しない。

すべての自然数 d、実数 H、および δ(λ) ≤ d と h(λ) ≤ H を満たす点 λ ∈ ℚ̄\{0,1} に対し、自然数 n と多項式 p ∈ 𝒫(d,H) が存在する。それらは n ≠ 0、n ≤ B(d,H)、p はモニック、p(nλ) = 0 を満たす。最後の等式は ℚ̄ の中で成り立つ。nλ は元の同じ点 λ の整数倍である。すべての λ が一つの固定した数体に属するという仮定はない。

semantic_boundaries.varying_fields: The final finite set ranges over algebraic points in ℚ̄ across varying minimal point fields F_λ = ℚ(λ). It is not fixed-field Northcott and is not a quotient by conjugacy.
semantic_boundaries.height_normalization: M_K is the unnormalized number-field multiplicative height; ℓ_K = log M_K. Point height is h(λ) = ℓ_{F_λ}(λ)/[F_λ:ℚ], the normalized absolute logarithmic height computed in the minimal point field.
semantic_boundaries.embeddings: The conjugate coefficient estimate quantifies over every complex embedding of the actual K. The witness proof uses every complex embedding of F_λ.
semantic_boundaries.zero_polynomial: 𝒫(d,H) includes 0, but the source root multiset of 0 is empty. R(0) = ∅ is essential to the finite-root statement.
semantic_boundaries.unconditional_minpoly_evaluation: The integer-minimal-polynomial evaluation theorem has no integrality premise; the polynomial is 0 by definition when the element is not integral over ℤ.
semantic_boundaries.statement_vs_construction: The witness statement requires a bounded monic integer polynomial; its source proof constructs the integer minimal polynomial in F_λ. The latter construction is recorded only in proof_notes.
